description:
Implement the component-server half of bitty#2496 for 0.0.27 in bitty-a11y.

Deliverable:
- bitty-component.toml (component a11y 0.0.1, protocol [1,1], executable bitty-a11y) with strict fail-closed descriptor validation.
- scripts/package-component.sh producing strict X.Y.Z Linux x86_64 tarball (descriptor plus executable), SHA256SUMS.
- Versioned length-prefixed protocol for bounded accessibility snapshots/diffs: snapshot request, tree rows (stable id, role, name, states, focus/selection, bounds), diff/ack, shutdown; hard caps on nodes/depth/bytes/rate; no arbitrary paths/argv/network.
- src/bin/bitty-a11y.rs server binary.
- Integration tests for snapshot/diff, stale ids, oversized/malformed frames, crash, and safe-mode/deprivation behavior; live smoke.

Out of scope: Core host client, SnapshotHost migration, linked dependency removal, AT-SPI/platform backend, Core changes, release/tag/artifact publication, and any claim that umbrella bitty#2496 is complete.

Integration authority (commander, 2026-10-23): merge a11y#18 only if normal branch policy permits; no --admin and no protection bypass. Independent review approved head 7edf5e7 as a PR comment because the author account cannot submit a formal self-approval. Branch protection requires one approving review from a non-author account, so the PR stays in review unless that review exists.

Non-blocking review residuals (rate-violation wording vs cumulative counter, rate-limited DiffAck request-id sentinel, CI persist-credentials hardening) are tracked in CTX-0010 and are intentionally not fixed in this task.
title: Component server half of a11y#2496: snapshot/diff protocol and packaging

description: Core PR #2547 pins the merged squash f7e57091ae12d4e179b059798cc234f074bfb111, but src/component/protocol.rs and src/component/server.rs use let-chain syntax stabilized after Rust 1.85, so cargo +1.85 check fails with E0658. Rewrite every let-chain expression in the crate and tests into 1.85-compatible nested if/match/boolean guards without changing behavior, ordering, short-circuit semantics, or borrow scopes; add an MSRV 1.85.0 --workspace --all-targets check to CI; verify fmt, clippy, tests, and just check. Branch ctx-0011/fix-msrv-let-chains. Core re-pin follows the squash merge SHA.
title: Restore Rust 1.85 MSRV: remove let-chain syntax and add MSRV CI gate
